description:
Annotate protein structures with hits to reference structures

The structure-input counterpart of domainate.py. Reads structure files (pdb/cif,
optionally gzipped, given as files, globs, or a directory searched recursively) or a
prebuilt foldseek database, aligns reference structures against them, and writes a protein
genbank file where every input chain is one record carrying Domainator features for the
references that hit it.

Every input record is written, whether or not it had hits, unless --hits_only is given.
Use structure_search.py instead when searching a large database with a few references.

References are aligned as the query and the input database as the target, so --evalue is
always computed against the database being annotated, exactly as it is for the rest of
domainator. The annotated coordinates are positions on the input record; the matching
positions on the reference are recorded in the /rstart, /rend and /rlen qualifiers.

Because the input database is built from real structures it carries C-alpha coordinates,
so --alignment_type 1 (TM-align) and the coordinate-based --metrics are available here.

Record coordinates are indices into the *observed* residue sequence extracted from the
structure, not original PDB residue numbers.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.help: structures to annotate: pdb/cif files (optionally gzipped), a directory to search recursively, a glob, or the prefix of a prebuilt foldseek database.

parameters.name: References
parameters.help: reference structures to annotate the input with. Same accepted forms as --input.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.help: output genbank filename. If not supplied, or if given as '-', writes to stdout.

parameters.name: Evalue
parameters.help: threshold E value for a hit. E values are computed against the input database.

parameters.name: Max Domains
parameters.help: maximum number of annotations to add per record. 0 means no limit.

parameters.name: Max Overlap
parameters.help: maximum fraction of overlap allowed between annotations on one record. 1 disables overlap filtering.

parameters.name: Alignment Type
parameters.help: how to compute the alignment: 0 = 3Di only, 1 = TM-align, 2 = 3Di+AA. Type 1 requires C-alpha coordinates in both databases.

parameters.name: Metrics
parameters.help: additional per-hit structural metrics to compute and store as feature qualifiers. tmscore, lddt and rmsd require C-alpha coordinates in both databases.

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.help: number of threads to give the backend. 0 lets the backend use all available cores.

parameters.name: Device
parameters.help: where to run the search. 'cpu' for a CPU-only search, or a CUDA device string ('cuda', 'cuda:0', 'cuda:1', ...) for a GPU-accelerated search. GPU search requires a recent foldseek. [default: cpu]

parameters.name: Hits Only
parameters.help: write only records that had at least one hit.

advanced_parameters.name: Min Evalue
advanced_parameters.help: minimum E value for a hit. Useful for excluding near-identical matches, such as a structure's hit to itself.

advanced_parameters.name: Overlap By Db
advanced_parameters.help: filter overlapping annotations within each database independently, instead of across all databases.

advanced_parameters.name: No Annotations
advanced_parameters.help: do not write Domainator features. Only meaningful together with --hits_only, where it selects hit records without annotating them.

advanced_parameters.name: Database Name
advanced_parameters.help: value for the /database qualifier on the annotations. Defaults to the reference database or directory name.

advanced_parameters.name: Keep Db
advanced_parameters.help: also write the aligner database built from the input structures, using this path as its prefix, so it can be reused as --input later.

advanced_parameters.name: Hits Tsv
advanced_parameters.help: write the backend's raw hit table here, for debugging or for cross-checking against a hand-run search.

advanced_parameters.name: Foldseek Path
advanced_parameters.help: path to the foldseek executable. If not supplied, foldseek is looked up on PATH.

advanced_parameters.name: Aligner Arg
advanced_parameters.help: extra arguments appended verbatim to the backend's search command line, for options domainator does not wrap. Example: --aligner_arg --prefilter-mode 2

advanced_parameters.name: Tmp Dir
advanced_parameters.help: parent directory for temporary databases and alignment files. Structural searches can need a lot of scratch space, so point this at a large filesystem for big inputs.

advanced_parameters.name: Max Seqs
advanced_parameters.help: maximum number of hits the backend keeps per reference. Raise this when searching a large database, otherwise coverage is silently capped.

advanced_parameters.name: Max Output Gb
advanced_parameters.help: Fail if a projected output file would exceed this many GB. Set to 0 to disable the guardrail.
